what: jais/GLaDOS published with this host's device placement; rebuilt from the portable Modelfile and re-pushed

defect.cause: publish-to-ollama.sh did `ollama cp glados jais/GLaDOS`; the local `glados` is the deployed, host-tuned build and parameters travel inside the manifest
defect.impact: every puller inherited num_gpu 0 (CPU-only inference regardless of their GPU) and num_thread 10 (fitted to one 2013 Xeon)

verified_on_the_pulled_copy.method: deleted the local tag, pulled jais/GLaDOS from the registry, read parameters off that copy
verified_on_the_pulled_copy.reply: Well, well, well. I see you've finally decided to grace me with your presence. How exciting.
verified_on_the_pulled_copy.note: the test request forced num_gpu 0 in its OPTIONS so it would not contend with the two T400s running the fly; the published artifact pins nothing

guards_added: publish-to-ollama.sh rebuilds the published tag from ./Modelfile when the source tag pins num_gpu/num_thread/main_gpu/low_vram/num_batch, instead of copying it
publish-to-ollama.sh reads the params layer back out of the registry after the push and fails if placement is present
reversibility: the previous manifest is recorded above; Modelfile.cpu-tuned rebuilds the old artifact exactly
